oneLiner: 单位时间内浓度的变化，衡量反应快慢。
oneLinerEn: Change of concentration per unit time; measures speed.
detail: v = Δc/Δt，同一反应中各物质速率之比等于化学计量数之比；不能用固体或纯液体表示。
detailEn: v = Δc/Δt; rates of species share the stoichiometric ratio; solids/liquids are excluded.

oneLiner: 浓度、压强、温度、催化剂都能改变反应速率。
oneLinerEn: Concentration, pressure, temperature and catalysts all change rate.
detail: 升温与加催化剂显著提高速率（增多活化分子/降低活化能）；增大浓度或压强增加单位体积内活化分子数。
detailEn: Heating and catalysts raise rate most (more activated molecules / lower activation energy); higher concentration or pressure packs more collisions.

oneLiner: 正逆反应速率相等、各组分浓度保持不变的可逆状态。
oneLinerEn: Forward and reverse rates equal; concentrations stay constant in a reversible reaction.
detail: 特征“逆、等、动、定、变”；平衡常数 K 只随温度变化，K 越大正向进行程度越高。
detailEn: Dynamic stillness; K depends only on temperature — larger K means greater forward extent.

subs.name: 氮气
subs.note: 合成氨原料，来自空气分离。

subs.name: 铁触媒
subs.note: 加快达到平衡，不改平衡位置。
subs.noteEn: Speeds arrival at equilibrium without shifting it.

oneLiner: 改变影响平衡的条件，平衡向减弱这种改变的方向移动。
oneLinerEn: When a stress is applied, equilibrium shifts to counteract it.
detail: 升温向吸热方向、增压向气体分子数少方向、增浓向消耗该物质方向移动；催化剂不移动平衡只加快到达。
detailEn: Heat→endothermic side, pressure→fewer gas moles, concentration→consume added species; catalysts only speed arrival.

oneLiner: 弱酸弱碱部分电离，存在电离平衡，用电离度与 Ka 描述。
oneLinerEn: Weak acids/bases partially ionize; described by degree of ionization and Ka.
detail: 加水稀释、升温促进电离；同离子效应抑制电离。Ka 越大酸性越强。
detailEn: Dilution and heat promote ionization; common-ion effect suppresses it. Larger Ka means stronger acid.

subs.name: 氢离子
subs.note: 电离出的阳离子，决定酸性。

oneLiner: 盐的离子结合水电离的 H⁺ 或 OH⁻，使溶液显酸性或碱性。
oneLinerEn: Salt ions take H⁺ or OH⁻ from water, making the solution acidic or basic.
detail: “谁强显谁性”：强碱弱酸盐水解显碱性（纯碱去油污），强酸弱碱盐水解显酸性；升温促进水解。
detailEn: The stronger partner sets the tone: basic salts from strong base + weak acid (washing soda degreasing); heating promotes hydrolysis.
